non_mac_execution_surfaces_probed_and_ab.probe_method: PATH lookup of every known local container/VM runtime, plus inspection of the standard local-runtime state directories
non_mac_execution_surfaces_probed_and_ab.conclusion: Zero non-Mac execution surfaces are reachable from this lane. A non-Mac qualification is not merely unattempted; it is impossible from here without an externally provisioned surface.

retained_physical_reproducibility_anchor.interpretation: The reachable Mac host already IS the retained physical anchor platform. Using it would re-observe the anchor, which is not a non-Mac qualification and is forbidden as a fallback. It would also be an unrepeatable, unowned local path (LOCAL_COURTS/ is untracked and machine-local), so it cannot serve as a frozen execution-surface identifier for a source warrant.

accepted_c3_source_free_runtime_anchor.definition: The distinct source-free qualification grade for accepted C3.
accepted_c3_source_free_runtime_anchor.interpretation: The accepted C3 runtime anchor deliberately records NO OS, NO architecture, and NO reader/decoder library version, because it never read a survey file. It therefore cannot be reused as evidence for any reader-side runtime claim, and cannot be inherited by name for a physical C4 run. The two anchors are correctly distinct and are preserved as distinct here.

no_install_on_import_no_silent_upgrade_a.verification: The lane's 14 source-free probes executed on the pre-existing uv environment as found. The probe harness treats ModuleNotFoundError for pandas, pytest and duckdb as RECORDED FINDINGS, not as something to remediate.
